newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU unemployment flat year-on-year in December.
newsitem.headline: EU unemployment flat year-on-year in December.

text.p: Unemployment in the 15-nation European Union was flat at 10.8 percent in December compared with a year earlier, although there was a slight improvement on November's figures, Eurostat said on Thursday.
The EU's statistics agency said the unemployment rate in December was highest in Spain at 22.2 percent and lowest in Luxembourg at 3.5 percent.
December figures were unavailable for Greece, Italy and the Netherlands.
On a monthly basis, Eurostat said that December's 10.8 percent represented a slight improvement on the 10.9 percent registered for each of the previous eight months.
Youth unemployment remained high, with a rate of 42.5 percent for men and women under 25 years old in Spain. Overall, the youth rate was 21.6 for the bloc, compared with 21.4 a year earlier.
* No figures for Netherlands, Greece, and Italy.
